lines: The alarm sound didn't stop ringing.
The wreckage of drones and the charred remains of soldiers were scattered around her, and the smell of burning materials filled the air.

「It's no use, run away!」
「Outta the way! Me first!!」
In the face of Astaroth's overwhelming power, the security guards took flight, scrambling over each other to escape.
「Oh? Are no more coming out? How dull...... Well then, allow me to go on ahead.」
Without even looking back at the singed room, she promptly headed to the storey above.
When she went up the stairs, the design of the place changed, and there was an opulent Japanese-style room lined with gold leaf.
「Is this the top floor? Is anyone here?」
There was a thunderous sound overhead, and the building shook.
When she looked, a hole had opened in the ceiling, large enough to think it was an atrium.
